obligations.statement: For each metal and owner, fine input equals fine outputs plus explicitly recorded loss.
assumptions: Fine amounts are exact normalized integer ticks; purity parsing and checked i128 representation remain unbound.

obligations.statement: Custody metal retains its owner and cannot be sold as company stock; custody operations have no company asset or ledger effect.
assumptions: One metal and one fixed custody owner; no title-transfer action.

obligations.statement: A refused operation preserves the entire stock, ledger and event state.
assumptions: Publication selects the old reference state on refusal; runtime atomic persistence remains unbound.
